array_syntax.name: array_syntax
array_syntax.summary: PHP arrays should be declared using the configured syntax.

phpdoc_align.name: phpdoc_align
phpdoc_align.summary: All items of the given PHPDoc tags must be either left-aligned or (by default) aligned vertically.

phpdoc_separation.name: phpdoc_separation
phpdoc_separation.summary: Annotations in PHPDoc should be grouped together so that annotations of the same type immediately follow each other. Annotations of a different type are separated by a single blank line.

phpdoc_trim.name: phpdoc_trim
phpdoc_trim.summary: PHPDoc should start and end with content, excluding the very first and last line of the docblocks.

yoda_style.name: yoda_style
yoda_style.summary: Write conditions in Yoda style (`true`), non-Yoda style (`['equal' => false, 'identical' => false, 'less_and_greater' => false]`) or ignore those conditions (`null`) based on configuration.
